units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Psalms 36:3">Targ. Ps. XXXVI, 3</cite> <he>למַשְׁכַּח</he> (ed. Wil. <cite ref="L00480"><he>למִ׳</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ecclesiastes 1:17">Targ. Koh. I, 17</cite> (ed. Vien. <cite ref="L00480"><he>למִ׳</he></cite>).
Ib. VIII, 17 (Pe interch. with Af.).

<cite ref="Onkelos Genesis 8:9">Ib. VIII, 9</cite> (Y. some ed. <he>הַשְׁ׳</he>). Targ. O. ib. XLI, 38 <he>הנַשְׁכַּח</he> ed. Berl. (ed. Vien. a. oth. <cite ref="E00911"><he>היִשְׁ׳</he></cite>, corr. acc.); Y. <he>הנִשְׁ׳</he>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Gittin 56b:17">Gitt. 56ᵇ</cite> <he>ליקלויה … דלא לַשְׁכְּחֵיה וכ׳</he> burn this man (me, Titus), and scatter the ashes …, that the God of the Jews may not find him and place him before judgment.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Eruvin 1:1:17">Y. Erub. I, 18ᵈ</cite> top <he>א׳ תני וכ׳</he> he found that it was taught (in the Boraitha), Rabbi says &c.
<cite ref="Yevamot 110b:12">Yeb. 110ᵇ</cite> <he>אַשְׁכְּחִתֵיה לרב וכ׳</he> I found Rab A. and &c.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 10a">Ab. Zar. 10ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. <he>נפק דק וא׳ וכ׳</he> he went forth, investigated, and found that &c.

<cite ref="Makkot 21b:5">Macc. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>מי מַשְׁכַּחַת וכ׳</he> wouldst thou have found the jewel beneath?; <cite ref="Bava Metzia 17b:3">B. Mets. 17ᵇ</cite> <he>לא משכחת</he>, v. <cite ref="D00828"><he>דְּלֵי</he></cite>.

<cite ref="Gittin 68a:11">Gitt. 68ᵃ</cite> <he>אַשְׁכְּחֵיה חמרא</he> he found it to be wine; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 78:7">Midr. Till. to Ps. LXXVIII, 45</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 182:4">Yalk. Kings 182</cite> <he>אשכח</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:1:10">Y. Ḥag. II, 77ᵇ</cite> <he>וי דמובדין ולא מַשְׁכְּחִין</he> woe for those who lose and do not find (who suffer an irretrievable loss)!; a. fr.—Macc. l. c., a. fr. <he>היכי משכחת לה</he> how wilt thou find it, i.e. to what practical case can this be applied? <cite ref="Pesachim 7a:3">Pes. 7ᵃ</cite> <he>בשלמא שבת משכחת לה וכ׳</he> as to the Sabbath, there may be a case, as, for instance, when the fourteenth day occurs on a Sabbath.
<cite ref="Avodah Zarah 40b">Ab. Zar. 40ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.
<cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 22:1">Ib. XXII, 1</cite>; <cite ref="Onkelos Exodus 22:3">3</cite>; a. fr.—
Targ. Y. I Deut. XXXIV, 8 הִשְׁתְּכָחוּ אכלין וכ׳ (= h. נמצא) consequently they ate &c., v. מָצָא.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 16b:9">B. Mets. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>הנהו … דמִשְׁתַּכְּחֵי בשוקא</he> deeds of purchase that were found in the street.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 111a">Snh. 111ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 6">Ex. R. s. 6</cite>, a. e. <he>ולא מִשְׁתַּכְּחִין</he> and are not found again (cannot be replaced), v. <cite ref="H00085"><he>חֲבַל</he> II</cite>; a. fr.
